Fragment of Roman Les Martres-de-Veyre samian ware cup, form Dr.27. by the potter Nicephor i dating to AD 100-130. Fragment consists of part of the base with foot ring and some of the cup walls rising up. There is a potter's stamp in the center of the cup interior.
